name: 「武林群侠传」之炎黄武魂Ⅱ
group_note: yh2003 codebase base (炎黄武魂Ⅱ). Status corrected from a stale 'limited' -- found and fixed a real bug this pass: adm/daemons/logind.lpc's check_ok() calls MESSAGE_D->find_chatter() completely unguarded on every successful login, and MESSAGE_D (adm/daemons/network/messaged.lpc) fails to compile under WASM (raw socket_create()/socket_bind() calls, sockets package unavailable) -- the resulting uncaught 'No program in object' runtime error aborted check_ok() mid-execution, silently leaving the connection in a broken state where every subsequent command (including quit) printed '什么？' with no room ever entered. Fixed by guarding the call with find_object(MESSAGE_D) (same fix applied to sibling yhyxs). Re-verified clean after the fix: admin login (fluffos/Mud@2026) enters the world normally, '目前权限：(admin)', quit clean.
